attempted_claim: Let H3 be the countable universal homogeneous triangle-free (Henson) graph on N and let G=Aut(H3) with the pointwise-convergence Polish topology. Let X={g in G: g^2=e}, closed hence Polish, with G acting continuously by conjugation. Is the restricted conjugacy relation E_G^X smooth, i.e. Borel reducible to equality on 2^N? A complete answer is either an explicit Borel complete invariant I:X->2^N with xE_G^Xy iff I(x)=I(y), proved Borel and correct, or a proof that some invariant dense G_delta X_0 subset of X is generically E_0-ergodic with meagre classes together with an explicit Borel E_0-hardness witness, so no such invariant exists.
decisive_failure: No complete invariant and no E_0-hardness witness was established; only a local triangle-free amalgam observation was computationally verified, while reduct universality, generic ergodicity, meagre classes, and Borel reduction correctness remain unproved and would require substantial further work.
